context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 農協/アポ/故に/計り/交差/つかめ/生後/下流

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、地方研究、農協の協同組合、テーマですね。
lines.en: Sakura — so your regional research theme is farm cooperatives.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Leaning in slightly. Affirming that she's heard and understood the scope. Professional but genuinely interested.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。インタビュー、アポ取りに、何度も電話しました。
lines.en: Yes. I made a lot of phone calls to set up the interviews.
lines.style: Quietly proud. Direct eye contact. Steady pace — showing the work mattered to her, not rushing past it. No apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域過疎、故に新たな取り組み、必要ですね。
lines.en: Regional depopulation is real, which is why these new initiatives are so necessary.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. Nodding slightly while speaking. Acknowledging the weight of what Sakura's studying without being heavy-handed about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。経済効果、計りに掛けるのは、難しいです。
lines.en: Right. It's hard to pin down the actual economic impact.
lines.style: Careful. A small pause before the main thought. Not uncertain — measuring her words because the question itself is complex. Slightly slower on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 産業と暮らしの交差点、興味深い章でしたね。
lines.en: That intersection between industry and daily life — that's what made that chapter so interesting.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm breaking through professional tone. Leaning forward slightly. She's spotting something smart in Sakura's work and letting her know.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 核心、つかめないまま終わった章、修正します。
lines.en: I didn't quite capture the core of it, though. I'm going to revise that section.
lines.style: Honest self-assessment. No drama. Matter-of-fact about the revision needed. The tone of someone who knows what good work looks like and isn't settling.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 生後すぐの幼児教育、別章で扱いましたね。
lines.en: Early childhood education came up as important — did you give that its own section?
lines.style: Asking for confirmation rather than correcting. Light, genuinely curious. The rhythm of a conversation between teacher and student who trust each other.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 下流地域の住民の声、最終章で総括しました。
lines.en: I brought in the voices of people actually living in those communities and used them to tie everything together in the final chapter.
lines.style: Calm confidence. She's described something substantial and knows it. Even pace, no trailing off. A small exhale of relief that the work is done, woven into the delivery.
